Metapod?! |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=The Beedrill All and End All |title_ja=VSスピアー |title_ro=VS Spear |image=PS088.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 88 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|7}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 48 in [[Lance's Charge]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 88 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|7}} |location=[[Cerise Island]] }} '''The Beedrill All and End All''' (Japanese: '''VSスピアー''' ''VS {{tt|Spear|Beedrill}}'') is the 88th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 48th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Yellow}} wonders who {{adv|Giovanni}} is, having never met him before; conversely, [[Pika]] is enraged to see Giovanni who merely sneers at him. Yellow, reading Pika's memories, realizes that Pika has fought with Giovanni. As [[Lance]] tries to hide using bubbles again, Giovanni sends out his {{p|Rhyhorn}} to blow sand all over the smaller bubbles, revealing them and allowing his {{p|Nidoqueen}} to break them. However, Nidoqueen is unable to break the main bubble. Lance mocks Giovanni, but Giovanni merely rolls his {{TP|Giovanni|Beedrill}}'s Poké Ball underneath the main bubble and pierces it with {{m|Twineedle}}, dropping Lance into the middle of the {{m|String Shot}} net and entangling him. Giovanni, looming over the bound Lance, declares that he cannot permit the [[Elite Four]] to wage war on [[Kanto]] before he can assume control over it. Lance merely acknowledges Giovanni as the leader of [[Team Rocket]], surprising Yellow who recognizes Giovanni as the one who attempted to exploit [[Viridian Forest]] two years in the past. Suddenly, high above a massive amount of energy gathers in the sky, much to Lance's pleasure. ==Major events== * {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia}}'s spirit appears above [[Cerise Island]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Adv|Yellow}} * {{Adv|Giovanni}} * [[Lance]] * {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Beedrill}} ({{OP|Giovanni|Beedrill}}) * {{p|Rhyhorn}} ({{Adv|Giovanni}}'s) * {{p|Nidoqueen}} ({{Adv|Giovanni}}'s) * {{p|Gyarados}} ({{OP|Lance|Gyarados}}) * {{p|Dragonair}} ([[Lance]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Golem}} (flashback) * {{p|Lugia}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia|Adventures}}; spirit form) ==Trivia== * This chapter is included in [[The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow]]. * The English title comes from the phrase "be all and end all", meaning the most important part or reason for something. ===Errors=== * In the [[VIZ Media]] second edition, the {{type|Ground}} is referred to as the Earth Type. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 大針蜂|VS Beedrill}} (Taiwan)
